SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NO LEGAL ADVICE
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Between Vertex Lumen Corp. and Orchard Signal Ltd.
Effective date: 1 July 2025.
Initial term: three (3) years.
The Parties perform their obligations in good faith and cooperate with each other. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

1. Definitions. Services means the services described in each work order. Fees means the amounts payable under Section 3.
Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud or wilful misconduct.
Each Party complies with the laws that apply to its own activities under this Agreement. Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has communicated to the other. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of that right.

3. Services and fees. The Supplier provides the Services described in each work order.
The monthly fee is USD 18,000, invoiced in advance on the first day of each month.
No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of that right. If a provision is held to be invalid, the remaining provisions continue in full force. This Agreement is amended only by a written document signed by both Parties.

4. Payment. Undisputed invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days of receipt.
Disputed amounts must be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of the invoice.
This Agreement is amended only by a written document signed by both Parties. Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party. The Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an agency.

5. Confidentiality. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for seven (7) years.
Each Party protects the other's confidential information with the care it uses for its own.
The Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an agency. Schedules and annexes form part of this Agreement unless they say otherwise.

6. Limitation of liability. Each Party's total liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.
The cap does not apply to the matters listed in Section 1.
Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement. Each Party complies with the laws that apply to its own activities under this Agreement. Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has communicated to the other.

7. Termination. Either Party may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice.
Either Party may terminate for cause if a material breach is not cured within thirty (30) days.
Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has communicated to the other. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of that right.

8. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
Disputes are finally settled by arbitration seated in London.
If a provision is held to be invalid, the remaining provisions continue in full force. This Agreement is amended only by a written document signed by both Parties. Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party.

9. Signatures. Signed by the authorised representatives of both Parties on the date shown on the first page.
Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party. The Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an agency. Schedules and annexes form part of this Agreement unless they say otherwise.

CONTRATO DE ARRENDAMIENTO DE LOCAL
Partes: Inmobiliaria Faro S.L. (arrendadora) y Panadería Estrella S.L. (arrendataria).
Fecha de vigencia: 1 de septiembre de 2025.
Duración inicial: cinco (5) años.

Primera. El local se destina exclusivamente a la actividad de panadería y pastelería.
Segunda. La arrendataria mantendrá el local en buen estado de conservación y uso.

Tercera. Queda prohibido el subarriendo total o parcial del local salvo consentimiento previo y por escrito de la arrendadora.
Cuarta. Las obras de reforma requieren autorización escrita de la arrendadora.

Quinta. La renta mensual es de 2.400 EUR, pagadera por meses anticipados.
Sexta. La renta se actualizará cada año conforme a la variación del IPC.

Séptima. Las partes podrán resolver anticipadamente el contrato con un preaviso de seis (6) meses por escrito.
Octava. Los gastos de comunidad corren a cargo de la arrendataria.

Novena. La arrendataria entrega una fianza de dos (2) mensualidades de renta, que se devolverá al finalizar el contrato.
Décima. La fianza no devenga intereses a favor de la arrendataria.

Undécima. Ley aplicable: España. Los tribunales de Zaragoza serán competentes para cualquier controversia.
Firmado en Zaragoza por ambas partes.
